name: Cherohala Skyway

terms.quote: Riding club, blog or ride report? Paste this and your readers get a card of the Cherohala Skyway that opens its map, GPX and directions. Free to use.

publishability.permission_notes: GPX is freely downloadable from MotoCurve and the page invites reuse of the route card; re-hosting the file itself is not explicitly granted.

value_reason: The Dragon’s big, fast neighbour: 50 mi of open sweepers above 5,000 ft, with a real track.
summary: The Cherohala Skyway (NC 143 / TN 165) from Robbinsville, NC, to Tellico Plains, TN: 50 mi measured of fast, open sweepers above 5,000 ft through the Cherokee and Nantahala National Forests. Where the Dragon is tight, the Skyway is wide and fast. No services on the Skyway itself.

surface.seasonality: Open all year, but the high section can close for snow and ice in winter.
surface.difficulty_source: MotoCurve page: 'Where the Tail of the Dragon is tight, the Skyway is fast and open: long sweepers'
